summary: Firefox significantly expanded Vulkan hardware video decoding on Linux, including **full support for newer NVIDIA GPUs** and improved codec coverage. Changes include better HDR metadata handling to prevent washed-out colors in hardware-decoded videos, safer initialization of Vulkan components, cached codec-support detection for better performance, and refinements to content protection synchronization. The work also restored and then refined the NVIDIA block-linear memory layout optimization for video decoding.
